base_prompt: Turkish alternative pop, intimate live studio band, instrumental only. Warm acoustic guitar, expressive piano, melodic electric bass, real drum kit, restrained clean electric guitar. Cohesive memorable recurring two-bar lead motif, human microtiming and touch, breathing room for a future singer. No EDM drop, no genre switch, no dense synth layers, no vocals or speech. Key E minor, 104 BPM, 4/4. Lead motif: The hook is a two-bar melodic line in E minor, starting on scale degree 5 (B4) on the upbeat of one, leaping up to 1 (E5) as a dotted quarter, descending step-wise (D5, C5, B4) in eighth notes in bar one, then resolving in bar two from 4 (A4) down to 3 (G4) with a syncopated, breathy vocal phrase..

timeline.name: intro
timeline.arrangement: Sparse fingerpicked acoustic guitar in E minor, establishing a melancholic 104 BPM groove. A warm, upright piano enters on the third bar playing gentle, ringing root-fifth dyads.

timeline.name: verse_1
timeline.arrangement: Subtle, unquantized acoustic kick drum on beats 1 and 3, with a soft wooden rim shot on beat 4. The electric bass enters playing smooth, melodic step-wise transitions. Fingerpicking continues.

timeline.name: pre_1
timeline.arrangement: A gradual dynamic build. Shaker enters with eighth-note patterns. Piano chords become more sustained, and a swelling ambient guitar pad rises in the background.

timeline.name: chorus_1
timeline.arrangement: The arrangement opens up. A strummed acoustic guitar takes over the rhythmic drive. Live, crisp snare drum on beats 2 and 4. A clean electric guitar plays the signature two-bar melodic hook in octaves.

timeline.name: turnaround
timeline.arrangement: The drums drop out except for a light, occasional rim shot. The hook guitar line slowly fades out with a warm tape-delay trail. Acoustic guitar reverts to sparse fingerpicking.

timeline.name: verse_2
timeline.arrangement: Kick and rim shot return with a slightly more active, syncopated bass line. Acoustic guitar maintains the fingerpicking pattern but adds subtle variations in the treble register.

timeline.name: pre_2
timeline.arrangement: Identical build structure to pre_1, but adding a subtle cello counter-melody in the lower-mid range to heighten the dramatic narrative of the departing partner.

timeline.name: chorus_2
timeline.arrangement: Full chorus energy. Open acoustic strumming, active live snare, and the prominent two-bar octave guitar hook. The bass line becomes more driving, using sliding octave fills.

timeline.name: bridge
timeline.arrangement: Strips back significantly. Acoustic guitar ceases strumming. The drums stop, leaving only a soft, warm Rhodes piano introducing a fresh harmonic color (Fmaj7). Vocal is intimate and close.

timeline.name: final_chorus
timeline.arrangement: The arrangement expands without shifting genres. Double-tracked acoustic guitars, driving snare, and a Hammond organ pad swelling underneath. The melodic hook guitar is doubled by a subtle piano line.

timeline.name: outro
timeline.arrangement: Resolves the tension. The drums and electric guitars fade out, leaving only the sparse fingerpicked acoustic guitar and a single, decaying piano chord on the tonic Em.
